inputs: Every input uses only 10-K/10-Q facts filed on or before the signal date. Now = values as of the signal date; a year ago = values as of the month end 12 months earlier (what was filed by then). TTM flows: net income, operating cash flow, revenue, gross profit (or revenue minus cost of revenue / cost of goods). Instants: total assets, current assets, current liabilities, long-term debt (noncurrent, else total). Share change = (market cap / adjusted close) now vs a year ago, which is split-safe; dividends bias it slightly toward 'no issuance'.

definitions.delta_roa: roa now - roa a year ago
definitions.revenue_growth: TTM revenue now / a year ago - 1
definitions.fscore: Piotroski signals passed / signals available (need >= 6 of 9): roa > 0; operating cash > 0; delta_roa > 0; operating cash > net income; long-term debt / assets fell; current ratio rose; share change <= +1%; gross margin rose; revenue / assets rose
definitions.drawdown: adjusted close / highest adjusted close over the last 252 sessions (same bar sequence) - 1
definitions.beaten_down: drawdown in the deepest third of the month's pool
definitions.cheap: book_to_price in the top third of the month's pool (from us-factor-study v3 value inputs)

baskets.profit_turn: TTM net income was negative a year ago and is positive now
baskets.loss_improving: TTM net income was negative a year ago and delta_roa > 0 (loss narrowed or turned to profit)
baskets.beaten_low_f: beaten-down and fscore <= 0.3 (contrast: beaten-down and getting worse)

scores.delta_roa: IC of delta_roa across the pool
scores.revenue_growth: IC of revenue_growth across the pool
scores.fscore: IC of fscore across the pool
scores.turnaround_score: equal-weight percentile composite of -drawdown (deeper = higher), delta_roa and revenue_growth; needs all three

evaluation: Same as pullback-check-v1: monthly signal, next-open entry, equal weight, one-month hold, excess over the equal-weight pool, 0.05% one-way cost times turnover, 6-month block bootstrap. Baskets with fewer than 5 stocks in a month are skipped that month. 3-month horizon is a gross diagnostic.
decision_rule: A basket counts as supported only if its one-month net-excess interval excludes zero AND its annual net excess is positive. Supported baskets replace the price-only bottoming list; otherwise the dashboard keeps a warning. 9 baskets and 4 scores are tested together.
note: US index union only (large and mid caps), 2017-2026, in-sample. Foreign filers (20-F) have no inputs and are excluded from fundamental baskets. Fixed before running; all results reported.
